description: This file implements contextual logging for the klog package in Kubernetes, providing functions to set, clear, and retrieve loggers, as well as manage contextual logging options and callbacks.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets a logger implementation for the klog package.

methods.name: SetLoggerWithOptions
methods.description: Configures the logger with additional options, including contextual logging and buffer writing.

methods.name: FromContext
methods.description: Retrieves a logger from the context or returns the background logger.

methods.name: TODO
methods.description: Returns the background logger as a last resort.

methods.name: LoggerWithValues
methods.description: Adds key-value pairs to the logger if contextual logging is enabled.

methods.name: LoggerWithName
methods.description: Adds a name to the logger if contextual logging is enabled.

methods.name: NewContext
methods.description: Creates a new context with the logger if contextual logging is enabled.
